description.value: Kin Pool is a municipal outdoor swimming pool in Nanaimo, formerly known as the Kinsmen Outdoor Swimming Pool. Operated by the City of Nanaimo as part of its Parks, Recreation & Culture department, it offers drop-in swimming in the Bowen Park area. For a touring cyclist on Vancouver Island, it can be a welcome place to cool off and clean up.
